title: AI Engineering Manager: Marketing & Personalization AI
description:
Proudly recognized as a Great Place to Work®, we are an AI\-native customer experience platform purpose\-built for emerging markets. With more than 25 years of conversational AI research and development, we serve over 5,000 enterprises across MENA and are pioneering sovereign, agentic AI through our Agentic Studio platform. As the category takes shape, the way Unifonic is perceived — by buyers, analysts, media, and the broader market — is a strategic asset. This role owns that perception.


We thrive on creativity, collaboration, and fun, where every idea is welcomed and celebrated. As shareholders in the company, we’re more than just communicators—we’re innovators shaping the future together. We are Unifones. Join us and be part of something extraordinary!

**Meet the team!**


Our Engineering team is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the systems and technologies that drive Unifonic’s solutions. We work closely with other departments to ensure our products and services meet the needs of our customers. If you are passionate about technology and are excited about working on cutting\-edge communication and engagement solutions, we want you on our team.


As an AI Engineering Manager, you will lead the team behind Unifonic's marketing and personalization AI, building the intelligence that determines who to engage, through which channel, at what time, and with what message. You will own the development and delivery of AI capabilities spanning audience segmentation, propensity and churn prediction, next\-best\-action and channel recommendations, send\-time optimization, campaign optimization, and generative AI for personalized content. These systems directly drive conversion, engagement, and customer retention for the brands we serve.


This is a hands\-on leadership role that combines people management with technical ownership. You will lead, mentor, and grow a team of talented AI engineers while actively contributing to architecture, technical design, code reviews, performance optimization, and proof\-of\-concept development. You will ensure the team delivers scalable, production\-grade AI solutions, foster engineering excellence, and cultivate a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.

**Help us shape the future of communications by:**

* Serving as the technical owner on AI model design, architecture, and integration for marketing and personalization use cases across the Unifonic product ecosystem.
* Owning the technical roadmap for personalization AI, recommendation and next\-best\-action engines, customer segmentation and propensity models, campaign and send\-time optimization, and generative AI for content personalization.
* Leading the evaluation, selection, and implementation of AI/ML frameworks, tools, and best practices, ensuring scalability, robustness, and maintainability.
* Participating in hands\-on coding, solution prototyping, and code reviews to maintain high\-quality standards and guide the team through complex technical challenges.
* Overseeing and refining the AI development lifecycle, including model training, validation, deployment, experimentation (A/B and uplift testing), and ongoing improvement.
* Leading a team of AI engineers, providing mentorship, regular feedback, and career development support.
* Defining clear performance expectations, conducting performance reviews, and identifying growth opportunities for team members.
* Fostering a positive, inclusive, and high\-performance team culture that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and collaboration.
* Collaborating with recruitment and HR to identify, attract, and retain top AI engineering talent, ensuring the team’s ongoing growth and success.
* Working closely with the Director of AI Development, Product Managers, Designers, Data Scientists, and other Engineering leaders to translate business requirements into technical roadmaps and actionable engineering plans.
* Ensuring seamless integration of AI capabilities into existing and future products, partnering with platform, infrastructure, and DevOps teams to optimize deployment and operations.
* Communicating technical topics effectively to non\-technical stakeholders, making recommendations and reporting progress, risks, and opportunities.
* Implementing and continuously improving the development processes, standards, and tools that drive efficiency, reliability, and scalability.
* Ensuring adherence to best practices in model governance, performance monitoring, and compliance with relevant data privacy and security regulations, including regional data residency requirements.
* Monitoring engineering metrics and KPIs, leveraging data\-driven insights to improve development velocity, code quality, and team efficiency and connecting model performance to marketing outcomes such as conversion, engagement, and retention.

 **What you will bring:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of software development experience with at least 3 years focused on AI/ML engineering and related technologies.
* Demonstrated experience building and shipping marketing or personalization AI in production recommendation systems, customer segmentation, propensity/churn/LTV modeling, real\-time decisioning, or campaign optimization with measurable impact on business KPIs.
* Proven track record of leading, mentoring, or managing engineering teams, preferably in high\-growth or innovative tech environments.
* Hands\-on experience with a range of AI/ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch), advanced modeling techniques (NLP, LLMs and generative AI, recommendation and ranking systems), and production\-grade model deployments.
* Solid grounding in experimentation and measurement, A/B testing, uplift modeling, and evaluating model impact on conversion, engagement, retention, and ROAS.
* Proficiency in Python, cloud platforms (e.g., OCI, AWS, GCP), CI/CD workflows, and modern software engineering practices.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate teams and build productive cross\-functional relationships.
* A strategic and solution\-oriented mindset, capable of balancing technical depth with big\-picture thinking.
* Experience with MarTech ecosystems, customer data platforms (CDPs), campaign orchestration, marketing automation, or CPaaS/omnichannel messaging platforms is preferred
* Experience applying LLMs to marketing use cases, content generation, conversational commerce, or agentic customer journeys including fine\-tuning and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), ideally within the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, tokenizers, and the model hub) is preferred
* Exposure to Rust for performance\-critical AI services, such as low\-latency inference, real\-time decisioning, or high\-throughput data pipelines is preferred.
* Arabic NLP experience or familiarity with the MENA market is preferred.
* Experience scaling teams and systems in a high\-growth SaaS environment is preferred.

**Craft \& Toolkit:**

* Machine Learning \& Deep Learning
* Generative AI \& LLMs
* Recommendation Systems \& Personalization
* Customer Segmentation, Propensity \& Churn Modeling
* Python
* TensorFlow / PyTorch
* Hugging Face \& RAG
* AWS / GCP / OCI
* MLOps \& CI/CD
* A/B Testing \& Model Evaluation
* Software Architecture \& System Design
* AI Engineering Leadership \& Team Management

**Character Traits:**

* Analytical thinking and problem\-solving – approach problems clearly, use data, and find solutions.
* Ownership and accountability – take responsibility and follow projects through to completion.
* Communication – explain ideas clearly and listen to others across teams.
* Collaboration – work well with others and support team goals.
* Adaptability and learning – adjust to change and keep learning new skills or tools.
* Mentorship and knowledge sharing – help others grow and share what you know.
* Resilience – stay calm under pressure and handle setbacks constructively.
* Quality and attention to detail – do work carefully and strive for improvement.
* Advocacy and innovation – encourage best practices, efficiency, and new ideas

**As a Unifone you’ll receive a range of benefits:**

* Competitive salary and bonus
* Unifonic share scheme (we are all owners!)
* 30 holiday days after the first anniversary
* Your Birthday off!
* Spend up to 25 days per year working from anywhere in the world!
* Paid leave for new parents

At WYLE, we are building an AI that runs the parts of your life you should not have to think about, so you get your time and attention back. Not another app. A Personal Operating System for people whose lives are too full to manage by hand.
 



 It has to work reliably in one real person's life, over years, in the actual mess of a real day. That is a hard engineering problem before it is anything else.
 



 This role owns one part of it: WYLE will not stay a wrapper around someone else's models. We are building toward smaller, faster models we run ourselves. You own that work, end to end.
 



  





**You are a fit only if:** 



* You have fine\-tuned real models (SFT, LoRA or QLoRA, preference tuning) and can show the result. Inspectable weights, benchmarks, or an eval someone can check. If you have never shipped a model another engineer could look at, this is not your role.
* You quantize with intent (GPTQ, AWQ, GGUF, FP8\) and own the accuracy\-versus\-latency trade\-off rather than guessing at it.
* You have run self\-hosted inference in production (vLLM, TGI, SGLang, or Triton), made it faster or cheaper, and can explain exactly how.
* You own the full loop, from data to training to quantization to serving. You are not a research scientist who hands off a checkpoint, and your AI experience is not just calling an API.
* Bonus: on\-device or edge inference, distillation, and low latency on ordinary consumer hardware.



  





**How we work.** 




 Engineering is horizontal on purpose. You work directly with the founder, everyone owns something real, and there are no layers between you and the decisions. This is for someone who has built inside a startup before and wants that again as an owner, not an employee.
 



 If you are a Head of Engineering, Director, Head of AI, Principal or Staff Engineer and what you miss is your hands on the keyboard owning what you build, this is for you. If you want another management seat, this is not.
 



  





**The honest part.** 




 This is a founding role, equity\-led with a partial salary for the founding team that steps up as our funding closes and moves to full market salary at the raise. We are direct about the full structure early, not after your time is spent. If you want a salary\-first role with a big team around you, that is fair, and this is not it.
 



 Dubai\-based, or ready to relocate quickly. We provide the visa and support the move.
 



  





**To apply:** 




 We read every application by hand, and this role is built so an auto\-apply agent cannot do it well. Do not use LinkedIn Easy Apply. Email ceo@wyle.ai, tell us Model and Inference is your domain, and point us at something you built that proves it: a model you trained, code, an open\-source project. Open with the hardest reliability or correctness failure you have owned in production and how you found it. Applications that open with a resume summary or a generic pitch, we pass on. We would rather see the work.

description:
Fuse Energy is a forward\-thinking renewable energy startup on a mission to deliver a terawatt of renewable energy \- fast. We're building the GPU/CUDA performance layer and the inference serving layer at the same time, from scratch \- and we're looking for the founding engineer to own the latter.
   

  

 We're looking for a Founding AI Inference Engineer to define and build how Fuse serves AI inference workloads at scale, reporting directly to the CTO. Where our CUDA and GPU engineering hires own kernel\-level and hardware performance, this role owns the layer above it: how models actually get served, scaled, and delivered against committed performance targets.
   

  

****The Opportunity****
 Fuse is seeing significant demand for data centre capacity across the markets we operate in, primarily for inference. Few companies in the world can pair real power delivery with real compute the way Fuse can, which puts inference serving at the heart of how we turn that advantage into the best offering in the market. That's this role.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define Fuse's inference serving strategy and architecture from first principles
* Design and build the serving stack: request routing, batching, scheduling, and autoscaling for high\-throughput, latency\-sensitive inference workloads
* Own model\-level optimisation strategy for serving \- deciding where and how to apply quantisation, distillation, speculative decoding, and similar techniques to improve throughput and cost per token, partnering with the CUDA/GPU engineers
* Make the core software architecture calls on serving frameworks and orchestration (e.g. vLLM, TensorRT\-LLM, SGLang, Triton Inference Server, or equivalents)
* Translate throughput, latency, and uptime commitments into concrete technical specifications and serving capacity plans
* Act as a direct technical owner of inference performance and reliability
* Work closely with the CUDA and GPU engineering teams to ensure custom kernels and hardware performance work are integrated cleanly into the serving layer

**Requirements**
* 4\+ years of experience building or operating large\-scale inference serving systems, or equivalent strong project/industry experience
* Deep, hands\-on experience with inference serving frameworks and the techniques used to optimise them (batching, KV\-cache management, quantisation, speculative decoding)
* Strong systems thinking \- able to reason about the full path from incoming request to served response across a large cluster
* Comfortable working directly with GPU/CUDA engineers to integrate low\-level performance work into a serving system
* A track record of making high\-stakes architecture calls and owning the outcome
* Comfort operating without a playbook \- this is a founding role shaping a new function around architecture that's still early\-stage, not joining an established one


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with Triton or custom ML inference/training frameworks
* Experience with autoscaling or capacity planning for large\-scale inference workloads
* Exposure to multi\-tenant serving or SLA\-driven infrastructure
* Background at a hyperscaler, frontier AI lab, or large\-scale distributed inference system
* Familiarity with Kubernetes/Slurm for cluster orchestration
* Interest or experience in energy markets, grid systems, or sustainability\-focused compute


**Benefits**

* Biannual bonus scheme
* Fully expensed tech to match your needs
* Breakfast and dinner allowance for office based employees

### **About the Role**


This is a **co\-founder opportunity** — not an employment contract. A pre\-seed AI startup in the DACH region is automating the public tender process for architecture and engineering offices. These firms spend 3–5 unpaid working days on each of the 40–60 procurement procedures they handle annually — up to €110,000 per year in unrecoverable time. The platform cuts that burden by 70–90%, handling everything from tender discovery and go/no\-go scoring to the automated generation of complete, office\-branded performance concepts (25–35 pages per application).


The founding team currently consists of two people: one covering strategy, sales, and procurement law, and one Full\-Stack \& AI engineer. You would be the third co\-founder, taking ownership of a core technical domain alongside the existing engineer.


The product is already live with an early customer, a second pilot is in preparation, and a public funding application (IBB Berlin ProFIT) is underway. The structural market opportunity is anchored by a multi\-year, €500B German federal infrastructure programme that feeds public procurement pipelines through at least 2036\.

### **What You'll Build**

* A generation engine that turns a firm's existing data into complete, compelling performance concept documents — compliant with German procurement law (VgV, HOAI)
* A reference database with automated maintenance of references, certificates, and CVs — including entity resolution, reliability scoring, and confidence quantification
* A clean, GDPR\-compliant cloud architecture hosted in the EU (AWS Frankfurt or equivalent)
* LLM/RAG pipelines that extract, structure, and reason over complex German\-language procurement documents

### **What We're Looking For**

**Required:**

* Strong full\-stack engineering skills with a track record of shipping product\-focused features end\-to\-end
* Hands\-on experience with LLMs, RAG, and/or NLP — or a clear ability and eagerness to go deep here quickly
* Entrepreneurial mindset: you want to build a company, not just resolve tickets
* Pragmatic and delivery\-oriented — ships rather than perfects endlessly
* Comfortable with the co\-founder role and equity\-based compensation at the early stage
* Professional\-level German (procurement law, customer communication, and the product itself are in German)

**Nice to have:**

* Prior experience building a product from 0 to 1
* Familiarity with German public procurement law (VgV, HOAI, Leistungsphasen)
* Experience with EU data residency and GDPR\-compliant SaaS architectures

**Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.**

### **Compensation \& Benefits**

* **Equity:** 15–20% co\-founder stake
* **Vesting:** 4\-year schedule with a 1\-year cliff
* **Salary:** Introduced once funding is secured; pre\-funding compensation is equity\-based
* Full\-time commitment preferred

### **Location**


The team is based in **Berlin, Germany**. Hybrid and fully remote arrangements within the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland) are possible.

**Join us in building the AI layer for Observability!**
 ClickStack is the open\-source observability platform we're building at ClickHouse — logs, metrics, traces, and session replays unified so engineers can find root causes quickly. The interesting work now is in the agent layer: systems that can investigate an incident at 2 AM, propose a root cause, and hand the on\-call a concise summary by the time they've logged in.
   

  

 We're hiring an AI Product Engineer to build agentic capabilities on top of a petabyte\-scale observability platform, with a focus on developer experience. If you've been building agents, designing skills, and wiring up MCP servers — and you've hit the limits of generic copilots for production work — we'd like to talk.
   

  

**What you'll do**
* **Build agents that investigate incidents.** 
 They surface anomalies, answer "why is production broken?", and use ClickStack as their substrate.
* **Write skills, not just prompts.** 
 Build a library of reusable skills that captures how our team debugs, finds root causes, writes ClickHouse queries, and runs incident response, so agents pick up the right playbook instead of starting from scratch.
* **Own the agent stack end\-to\-end.** 
 Context engineering, tool design, evals, tracing, cost. You're responsible for whether the agent works in production.
* **Make ClickStack a great place to run AI workloads.** 
 Build the MCP servers, SDKs, and integrations that let customers' agents read telemetry, take action, and stay observable themselves.
* **Work in the open.** 
 Collaborate with OSS contributors and customers, debug their problems alongside them, and feed what you learn back into the product.

 Latency, cost, context window limits, eval coverage, hallucinations on real telemetry.

* Active in open source and the developer community.

title: Founding ML Engineer (Spectrum)
description:
Software engineers and AI agents alike suffer from the same problem: finding that one person or place that will answer their tough, specific question. Many solutions promise to solve this with similarity search in vector databases. Unfortunately, finding the answer is often a puzzle with pieces to be collected across a myriad of contradictory sources and cannot be solved without surgical search and careful reasoning.
   

  

 Spectrum collects data from an organization’s code, docs, and issues, and organizes knowledge in a unified ontology that AI agents can efficiently search through and reason over. We aim to revolutionize the semantic layer space for software\-building organizations and move beyond specs that fall out of sync with code, introducing a living spec – one that’s extracted from the whole system and used to keep it aligned. Spectrum is meant to be the single source of truth for all product and architectural knowledge.
   

  

 Spectrum is a resident of JetBrains' startup incubator, with startup speed and autonomy, and backed by 25 years of developer tooling expertise. We are looking for a top\-class ML Engineer who will help us shape the future of software development. You will own our AI and ML engineering stack and help define the research agenda for our team. Your technical vision and design decisions will directly shape the product and determine its success.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Include**
* Designing and building the ML/LLM solution for data ingestion, knowledge extraction, retrieval, and subsequent reasoning.
* Creating the datasets, metrics, and pipelines that drive measurable improvements across the system.
* Architecting and improving agents for context retrieval, knowledge extraction, and data alignment, which includes prompt engineering, model selection, and inference optimization.
* Establishing MLOps practices, including orchestration, observability, and experiment tracking.
* Collaborating with the engineering team on system design and with JetBrains Research on the research agenda.
* Defining hiring criteria, growing the ML team, and shaping the ML team culture.


**We Expect You To Have**
* A proven track record as an ML/AI Lead.
* At least five years of experience in ML/AI systems, with at least two years focused on LLMs and generative AI.
* A deep understanding of the LLM ecosystem, including model architectures and fine\-tuning approaches.
* Hands\-on experience with:
+ Prompt engineering and LLM pipeline design, including evaluation.
+ Agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangSmith, smolagents, or an equivalent.
+ Vector databases and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) patterns.
+ Deploying and scaling LLM\-powered applications using APIs (e.g. OpenAI or Anthropic) or open\-source models.

* Strong Python skills – Kotlin knowledge would be a plus.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Proficiency in English, both written and verbal.


**Our Ideal Candidate Would Have**
* Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs, or graph\-based reasoning.
* Experience in early\-stage startups – you enjoy the zero\-to\-one phase.
* The ability to think strategically about product\-led AI, beyond just training models in isolation.
* A background in code analysis, developer tools, or software engineering research.
* Experience with multi\-agent systems or complex agentic workflows.
* Actively contributed to relevant open\-source projects or publications.


 What we offer
   

  

* A competitive salary and JetBrains benefits.
* A generous runway and corporate resources with startup autonomy.


**We are an equal opportunity employer**

title: Staff AI Engineer | Robot Autonomy
description:
**Staff AI Engineer \| Robot Autonomy** 




**Munich \| €90,000 \- €130,000 \+ ESOP \| Humanoid Robotics** 




  





 Teaching a robot to move an object across a table is one problem.
 



  





 Teaching it to find that object in an unfamiliar home, navigate towards it, pick it up safely and bring it to someone is a very different one.
 



  





 I’m working with an early\-stage humanoid robotics company in Munich that is developing assistive robots for elderly people and their families. The technology has already been tested in real homes, and the next challenge is moving from individual demonstrations towards reliable autonomous behaviour.
 



  





 They are now hiring a Staff AI Engineer to take ownership of the robot\-learning stack across data collection, model training, evaluation and deployment onto physical hardware.
 



  





**The role** 




 You will teach a physical robot to complete useful manipulation tasks in real domestic environments.
 



  





 The robot can already perform static pick\-and\-place tasks and operate light switches. The next behaviours include locating requested objects within a room, navigating towards them, retrieving items from the floor, handing them to a person and helping with tasks such as opening a water bottle.
 



  





 These tasks are not exceptionally complex in a controlled laboratory. The difficulty is making them work reliably across different homes, objects, lighting conditions, layouts and users.
 



  





 You will own the complete learning loop rather than focusing on one isolated model or research problem.
 



  





**What you will be working on** 



* Designing real\-world demonstration and data\-collection workflows
* Training manipulation policies using learning from demonstration and behavioural cloning
* Applying reinforcement learning where it provides a practical improvement
* Adapting existing foundation models rather than building a general\-purpose model from scratch
* Evaluating policies on physical robots and understanding why they fail
* Deploying models onto real robotic systems
* Improving performance using data collected from deployed robots
* Building repeatable training, evaluation and deployment workflows
* Working closely with the robot platform and data infrastructure engineers
* Helping define the long\-term autonomy architecture as the robot fleet grows



  





 The likely technical direction includes existing VLM and VLA systems, NVIDIA GR00T, Pi\-style models, diffusion policies, world models and action\-chunking approaches.
 



  





 The expected balance is approximately
 **60% engineering and deployment, with 40% research** 
 . This is a hands\-on individual\-contributor role rather than a research\-management position.
 



  





**What they are looking for** 



* Experience taking a learning\-based manipulation system from data collection through to deployment on a physical robot.
* End\-to\-end robot learning on real hardware
* Manipulation, rather than perception alone
* Learning from demonstration, imitation learning or behavioural cloning
* Practical reinforcement\-learning knowledge
* Strong Python and modern deep\-learning frameworks
* C\+\+ and strong general software\-engineering foundations
* ROS2
* Robot kinematics, dynamics and control
* Training, evaluating and deploying policies on physical robots
* Debugging failures involving calibration, latency, contact, data quality and hardware variation
* Taking ownership of ambiguous technical problems without waiting for a complete specification



  





 A strong publication record is useful, but it will not replace evidence that you have built and deployed a working system.
 



  





 Candidates whose experience is limited to simulation, object segmentation, grasp detection or isolated motion\-planning research are unlikely to be close enough to the problem.
 



  





**Useful additional experience** 



* VLA models
* World models
* Diffusion policies or diffusion transformers
* Action chunking
* Bimanual or mobile manipulation
* Humanoid or dexterous robotics
* Jetson deployment and inference optimisation
* Compliant actuation or force\-sensitive manipulation
* Continual or distributed learning systems
* Open\-source robot\-learning projects
* Experience collecting demonstrations through teleoperation



  





**The type of background that could fit** 



* Humanoid robotics
* Mobile manipulation
* Dexterous manipulation
* Warehouse picking
* General\-purpose robot\-learning platforms
* Robotics foundation\-model teams
* Academic robot\-learning groups with substantial hardware ownership



  





**What’s in it for you?** 




 The product is intended to support elderly people who want to retain more independence within their own homes.
 



  





 This is not a humanoid programme searching for a future use case. The team has already worked with elderly users and seen genuine demand for the product.
 



  





 You would be joining early enough to define how the autonomy system is built, while working directly with the CTO in a small and highly technical team.
 



  





 There is no mature legacy architecture to inherit. The successful hire will help decide the models, tools, data loops and engineering standards that the company builds around.
 



  





 The work will move quickly from code and experiments to physical robots operating in real environments.
 



  





**Location and package** 



* **Location:** 
 Munich

 Predominantly onsite due to the need to work with physical hardware; flexibility to work remotely when the task allows

Wir gehören zu den Top\-Adressen in der IT\-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT\-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.
   

  

**DEINE ROLLE**
* In a nutshell: In interdisziplinären Projektteams übernimmst du gemeinsam mit deinem Team abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten in technisch anspruchsvollen kundenspezifischen Softwareprojekten aus dem gesamten Engineering\-Prozess. Von der Anforderungsanalyse und dem fachlichen bzw. technischen Systementwurf über die Programmierung und Implementierung bis hin zur Qualitätssicherung und dem Projektmanagement. Die Projekte basierend auf dem bewährten Java\- / JavaScript\-Stack (Web\-Frontends mit Java Backends) und AI\-Prozessen (oft im Python\-Stack).
* AI\-Transformation: Du transformierst unsere Software\-Engineering\-Prozesse, indem du generative AI\-Tools (wie GitHub Copilot, Cursor, LLMs) in den gesamten SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) integrierst.
* Konzeption und Entwicklung: Du arbeitest in den Bereichen Konzeption, Entwicklung und Design von Java\- und AI\-Anwendungen in einem agilen Projektumfeld.
* Konzipiere Microservice\-Architekturen: Du konzipierst und realisierst moderne Microservice\-Architekturen und verteilte Systeme in vollem Umfang.
* Projektbegleitung: Von der Idee bis zum Go\-live begleitest du die Lösungen sorgfältig.


**DEIN PROFIL**
* Starker Hintergrund: Du bringst einen starken Hintergrund in Java\-Backend\-Entwicklung, AI\-Programmierung und Software\-Engineering mit.
* Java\-Backendentwicklung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Java\-Backendentwicklung webbasierter, skalierbarer Systeme und Anwendungen mit verschiedenen Datenbanken und Frameworks (z.B. Spring/Spring Boot, Hibernate) in einem agilen Projektumfeld helfen dir, alle Herausforderungen zu meistern. Du hast Spaß daran, Kunden durch die digitale Transformation in hochmoderne Prozesse zu führen.
* AI\-Programmierung: Praktische Kenntnisse in der Programmierung von AI\-Anwendungsfällen mit verschiedenen Frameworks bringst du ebenfalls mit.
* Generative AI: Du hast Interesse an generativer AI (GenAI, GPT, Gemini, Llama, LangChain/LlamaIndex und Co.) und erste Erfahrungen im Bereich MLOps.
* Sprachkenntnisse: Für deine Tätigkeit benötigst du sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1\-Level) und gute Englischkenntnisse.


 Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir\-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.
   

  

 Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home\-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1\. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

title: Principal/Lead SAP AI Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
**We help the world run better**
 At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
   

  

**Where You Belong**
 You will join a high\-performing, innovation\-driven SAP AI architecture and engineering team at the intersection of enterprise SAP and artificial intelligence. Guided by our ambition —
 *“Architect the Autonomous Enterprise, Develop and Deliver Today”* 
 — we turn complex ideas into scalable, production\-grade SAP solutions.
   

  

 The preferred candidate will possess insatiable curiosity, unbounded creativity, and a growth mindset to navigate ambiguity and deliver clarity within complex SAP environments. Driven by a passion for mentoring and a deep desire to teach and learn, they will naturally translate business problems into elegant SAP\-native architectures and solutions while actively giving and receiving feedback to maximize the team's collective knowledge and best practice development.
   

  

**What You’ll Build**
* Customer\-Focused Outcomes: As a Senior SAP AI Engineer (f/m/d), you will be a key driver of customer value delivery, translating SAP AI architectural blueprints into fully functional, scalable, and production\-ready solutions. Specifically, you will:
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions through workshops, prototyping, and iterative delivery
* Collaborate with customers across the delivery lifecycle (workshops, reviews, UAT) to refine and optimize solutions
* Design and implement production\-grade AI solutions on SAP AI Foundation, covering data, models, APIs, front\-end integration, agent\-to\-agent communication workflows
* Deliver Generative AI use cases on SAP BTP (e.g., RAG pipelines, chatbots, document processing, AI\-driven workflows)
* Build and manage SAP AI Core pipelines, including training, model serving, and monitoring for production readiness
* Develop conversational and agent\-based AI solutions (e.g., SAP Joule) to enable natural language interaction with SAP processes
* Build end\-to\-end SAP applications using CAP and Fiori, creating intuitive, AI\-augmented user experiences
* Design and orchestrate agent\-based workflows across SAP and non\-SAP systems for intelligent automation
* Functional Contributor for the Team: Beyond individual delivery, you will play an important role as a senior technical voice and enabler within the engineering team. Specifically, you will:
* Define and promote SAP AI development standards, including coding practices, reusable components, and deployment guidelines
* Conduct code reviews and peer assessments, providing high\-quality feedback to improve solution quality and team capability
* Mentor and support engineers through knowledge sharing, pair programming, and technical coaching
* Contribute to pre\-sales by developing and presenting PoCs and technical demos showcasing SAP AI capabilities
* Support Agile delivery processes (e.g., sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation) with strong technical input
* Stay current with SAP AI and broader AI ecosystem trends, driving continuous innovation within the team


**What You Bring**
* Education \& Track Record
* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, Information Systems, or a related field
* 7\+ years of software development experience, including 5\+ years in SAP BTP development and/or AI/ML engineering in enterprise SAP environments
* Proven track record of delivering production\-grade SAP AI solutions across full project lifecycles (design, development, deployment) using modern frameworks (e.g., CAP, Fiori, Integration Suite)
* Professional fluency in German and English (C1\+)
* Core Architecture \& Engineering Skills
* Solid understanding of SAP architecture principles and proven ability to design robust integration architectures
* Strong Python skills for AI/ML development (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, scikit\-learn, pandas, NumPy) in SAP AI Core environments
* Solid experience in SAP BTP development and subaccount management
* Proficiency in SAP CAP (Node.js/Java) for building scalable, cloud\-native applications and AI\-enabled services
* Experience with SAP Fiori/UI5 to develop and extend AI\-powered user interfaces
* Understanding of S/4HANA extensibility patterns (side\-by\-side, in\-app, key\-user) aligned with Clean Core principles
* Strong API development skills (REST, OpenAPI, versioning) and SAP API Management
* SAP AI \& Agentic AI Skills


- SAP AI, Agentic AI \& Generative AI Expertise

* Hands\-on experience with SAP AI Foundation, including model deployment, serving, and workflow orchestration
* Experience with SAP Generative AI Hub for managing LLM providers (e.g., Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI)


- Agentic AI \& Multi\-Agent Systems

* Strong knowledge of agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI)
* Experience designing multi\-agent architectures (task orchestration, state management, delegation, error handling)
* Ability to build conversational AI systems with context management, memory, and multi\-turn interactions
* Familiarity with SAP Joule integration and extending it with custom skills and agents


- Generative AI \& LLM Engineering

* Expert\-level prompt engineering skills (e.g., few\-shot learning, prompt chaining, context optimization)
* Hands\-on experience with RAG architectures (chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval strategies)
* Data \& Integration Skills
* Proficiency in SAP BDC, including data product design, data integration, and use of Datasphere data in AI pipelines
* Experience with SAP Integration Suite (e.g., Cloud Integration, API Management, Event Mesh) to connect AI services with SAP processes
* Proficiency in SAP Cloud Connector and Destination Service for secure connectivity between BTP and backend systems
* Experience with SAP OData services and RAP for exposing and consuming S/4HANA data in AI\-enabled applications
* AI Quality \& DevOps Skills
* Experience with SAP AI Core MLOps capabilities (e.g., training pipelines, model management, and inference endpoints)
* Proficiency in SAP AI Launchpad for monitoring and managing AI scenarios across BTP environments
* Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines on SAP BTP (e.g., SAP CI/CD service, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)
* Knowledge of SAP BTP security best practices (e.g., OAuth2/XSUAA, secret management, encryption, Responsible AI compliance)
* Soft Skills, Project Management Skills \& Leadership Skills
* Strong communication skills, able to explain complex SAP AI concepts to both technical and business stakeholders
* Strong ownership mindset, ensuring quality, reliability, and timely delivery
* Analytical and structured problem\-solving approach
* Adaptability and continuous learning mindset within evolving SAP AI landscapes
* Solid understanding of Agile and SAP Activate methodologies
* Mentoring and knowledge\-sharing mindset, supporting team growth
* Customer\-focused approach, aligning development with business outcomes


 \#SAPAICareers
   

  

**Bring out your best**
 SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end\-to\-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose\-driven and future\-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

 Building autonomous driving systems at production scale takes more than strong model architectures. It requires robust end\-to\-end machine learning systems that perform reliably across edge cases, ODD boundaries, and global market conditions.

Wünschenswert sind Erfahrungen in einschlägigen Conversational\-AI\-Plattformen wie beispielweise Cognigy, Parloa, Google, Kore.ai oder Amazon Lex.
* Prompting Intuition: Du hast ein Talent dafür, Anweisungen an eine KI so präzise zu formulieren, dass das gewünschte Ergebnis erzielt wird, und erkennst schnell, warum ein Prompt scheitert.

* Consulting\-Mindset: Du möchtest nicht nur Aufgaben abarbeiten, sondern verstehen, welches Problem wirklich gelöst werden soll, um die bestmögliche technische Beratung zu bieten.

 Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.
   

  

 Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home\-Office. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Artificial intelligence is transforming the way we work, make decisions, and automate processes. As an AI Engineer (gn), you bring AI to where it creates real value in day\-to\-day business: translating business requirements into practical, production\-ready AI solutions built on our existing tool landscape and an emerging company\-wide AI platform.



You work hands\-on with our AI tools, including Claude Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise, and n8n, building workflows and use cases, advancing our AI tooling, and helping introduce, consolidate, and govern new technologies. You think end\-to\-end—from the initial problem statement through implementation and deployment.



Due to organizational and regulatory requirements, **residency in Germany is required** for this position.


### **Your mission**


* ### **Translate Business Requirements into AI Solutions**


	+ Translate business requirements into concrete, implementable AI solutions, working closely with Business, Security, and Engineering teams.
	+ Own AI use cases from the initial idea through production deployment, including implementation, stakeholder alignment, documentation, and transparency.

	+ Work hands\-on with our enterprise AI tools (Claude Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise) and help improve their capabilities and usability.

	+ Connect structured and unstructured data sources, prepare them for AI applications, and ensure high\-quality retrieval using technologies such as **embeddings, vector search, and reranking**.
	+ Contribute to the development of our emerging enterprise AI platform—from answering questions to making recommendations and enabling AI\-assisted actions with human approval.
	+ Empower business teams to adopt AI securely and effectively while acting as a technical sparring partner for Business and Engineering.

**What Makes This Role Special**
--------------------------------



In this role, you work closely with the people who use AI every day. You transform real business needs into working solutions—whether as n8n workflows, use cases on our enterprise chat platform, or applications on our company\-wide AI platform. You'll join an environment that is evolving rapidly, where many AI initiatives are still taking shape.  The world of sports excites, connects, and inspires. At SPORTFIVE, we are a global agency that covers every aspect of sports marketing, helping to shape the industry‘s future with fresh and exciting ideas.
   

  

**DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION**
 We believe that different perspectives and experiences are the key to sustainable success. Our goal is to create an authentic and attractive work environment where everyone feels valued, with a sense of belonging, and encouraged to shape the future of the sports industry together.
   

  

**FLEXIBILITY THAT FITS YOUR LIFE**
 Whether you’re seeking a role that is full\-time, part\-time, or a job share, we understand that everybody has their own unique needs. That’s why we offer a range of flexible working options which we can discuss with you to find the best solution for you.
   

  

 An exciting opportunity to shape and advance innovative AI capabilities across SPORTFIVE's Global IT organization in Hamburg. Our colleague Chiron de Jong is looking for you to join his team and play a key role in implementing, governing and expanding our Microsoft AI ecosystem as:
   

  

**Microsoft 365 Copilot \& AI Engineer (m/f/d)**
 Full\-time \| Part\-time \| Job\-sharing
   

  

 You will be responsible for the implementation, administration, governance, and adoption of AI capabilities across SPORTFIVE.
   

  

 You will act as the technical owner for our Microsoft AI ecosystem, helping business teams identify opportunities, deploy AI solutions securely, and ensure that AI technologies deliver measurable value across the organization.
   

  

 This role focuses on implementing, governing, and operating Microsoft AI technologies rather than developing machine learning models, training AI systems, or building Large Language Models from scratch.
   

  

**YOUR ROLE AT A GLANCE**
**You...**
* administer, govern and continuously improve Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio environments and related AI services and solutions
* support the rollout and adoption of new Microsoft AI capabilities across the organization
* ensure AI services operate securely and in compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements
* define and maintain governance, security and operational standards for AI technologies
* collaborate with business teams to identify practical AI use cases and translate requirements into scalable solutions
* design and implement AI\-enabled business solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Azure OpenAI and related Microsoft technologies
* leverage Microsoft technologies such as Entra ID, Purview, Microsoft Graph, Conditional Access, and Data Loss Prevention to enable secure AI adoption
* create reusable solutions, best practices, and standards that can be applied across the organization
* provide technical guidance, training, and support to help users successfully adopt AI technologies
* stay up to date with developments in Microsoft's AI ecosystem and evaluate opportunities to drive business value through innovation


**What You’ll Bring** 
  

  

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Informatics or a related field
* Experience administering Microsoft 365 services in an enterprise environment, including collaboration, security, identity and productivity solutions
* Strong knowledge of the Microsoft AI ecosystem, including Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio
* Good understanding of identity, security, and compliance concepts within Microsoft environments, including Entra ID, Purview, Conditional Access and Data Loss Prevention
* Hands\-on experience with one or more of the following technologies:
+ Microsoft Copilot Studio
+ Microsoft Graph \& Fabric
+ Power Platform\- \& Automate
+ Azure OpenAI Services

* Understanding of modern AI concepts such as Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering and responsible AI practices, with the ability to apply these concepts using Microsoft technologies
* Experience translating business requirements into practical and scalable AI solutions
* Familiarity with automation, scripting, and system integration using PowerShell, APIs, or similar technologies
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across both technical and business teams


**DON’T MEET ALL THE CRITERIA? NO WORRIES!**
 For us, people and potential come first. Your enthusiasm for the role and SPORTFIVE, as well as your willingness to learn and develop, are just as important as your skills. We see potential as the key to success and are committed to helping you grow and acquire new skills on your journey with us.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Onboarding: To ensure that you are set up for success when you join us, we offer a role and department specific onboarding program, complemented by a company\-wide introduction where you get to know your colleagues, our diverse products, and different business areas.
* Work\-Life\-Integration: Our flexible working arrangements include mobile working, additional child sick leave days, and a free family service.
* Individual Development: Room for personal and professional growth, supported by customised training opportunities, development planning, internal mentoring, and on\-the\-job training.
* Attractive Benefits: Discounts at partner companies, event tickets, company pension plan, Germany ticket, job bike, mental health programs, and Urban Sports Club memberships.


 We are happy to offer this role as a job\-sharing position. To find your perfect tandem partner (m/f/d) and apply as an unbeatable match, please apply on our partner's website PairToShare.
   

  

 We believe diversity strengthens our team, so we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. Please let us know if there is anything we can do to ensure you feel fully supported throughout the application process.
   

  

**SOUNDS EXCITING?**
 Let’s go! Hannah Albrecht\-von Spreecken is your recruiting contact and looks forward to getting to know you.
   

  

**Start Date**
 07/01/2026
   

  

****SPORTFIVE Global Holding GmbH****

title: AI Engineer (gn)
description:
Start: ab sofort \| Level: Mid \- Senior \| Location: Deutschland, remote \| Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit (40h/Woche)
   

  

 Künstliche Intelligenz verändert die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, Entscheidungen treffen und Prozesse automatisieren. Als AI Engineer (gn) bringst du AI dorthin, wo sie im Arbeitsalltag echten Mehrwert schafft: Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus den Fachbereichen in konkrete, produktive AI\-Lösungen – auf Basis unserer Tool\-Landschaft und einer entstehenden unternehmensweiten KI\-Plattform.
   

  

 Du arbeitest hands\-on mit unseren AI\-Werkzeugen wie Claude Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise und n8n, baust Workflows und Use\-Cases, entwickelst unsere AI\-Tools weiter und hilfst dabei, neue Tools einzuführen, zu konsolidieren und sinnvoll zu governen. Dabei denkst du von der ersten Fragestellung bis zur Umsetzung.
   

  

 Aufgrund organisatorischer und regulatorischer Anforderungen ist für diese Position ein
 **Wohnsitz in Deutschland erforderlich** 
 .
   

  

**Deine Mission bei uns**
* Anforderungen in AI\-Lösungen übersetzen
+ Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus den Fachbereichen in konkrete, umsetzbare AI\-Lösungen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Business, Security \& Engineering zusammen.
+ Du übernimmst Use\-Cases von der ersten Idee bis in den produktiven Betrieb – inklusive Umsetzung, Abstimmung, Dokumentation und Transparenz.
+ Du bringst KI / LLMs und Agenten in produktive Workflows und arbeitest mit am Aufbau einer zentralen AI\-Infrastruktur/Plattform


**Mit unserer AI\-Tool\-Landschaft arbeiten und sie weiterentwickeln**
* Du arbeitest hands\-on an unseren Enterprise\-AI\-Tools (Claude Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise) und hilfst, sie weiterzuentwickeln und besser nutzbar zu machen.
* Du baust und betreust Workflows und Automatisierungen in n8n und unterstützt Teams dabei, sie eigenständig zu nutzen.
* Du evaluierst und führst neue AI\-Tools ein, konsolidierst bestehende und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Security Standards und Governance (z. B. für n8n).
* Du entwickelst konkrete AI\-Anwendungsfälle – z. B. RAG\-Anwendungen, Chat\-Assistenten oder Agenten, die Fragen beantworten, Hinweise geben oder mit menschlicher Freigabe Aufgaben ausführen.
* Du entwickelst Governance\-Modelle, Rollen\- und Berechtigungskonzepte sowie technische Leitplanken für den Einsatz von AI im Unternehmen.


**Daten nutzbar machen \& nsere KI\-Plattform aufbauen**
* Du bindest strukturierte und unstrukturierte Datenquellen an, bereitest sie für AI auf und sorgst für gutes Retrieval (z. B. Embeddings, Vektor\-Suche, Reranking).
* Du entwickelst unsere entstehenden, unternehmensweiten KI\-Plattform mit – von „Antworten“ über „Empfehlen“ bis „Handeln mit Freigabe“.
* Du befähigst Fachbereiche, AI sicher und effektiv einzusetzen, und bist technischer Sparringspartner für Business und Engineering.
* Du bewertest neue Integrationen, Connectoren und Plattformfunktionen hinsichtlich Risiken, Governance und technischer Umsetzbarkeit.


 Deine Erfahrung \& Skills
   

  

  

* Erfahrung darin, Business\-Anforderungen in technische AI\-Lösungen zu übersetzen – idealerweise mit projekthaftem oder beratungsnahem Hintergrund.
* Erfahrung in der Integration von KI / ML, LLMs und Agentic AI in produktive Workflows.
* Erfahrung mit Automatisierungstools wie n8n (oder vergleichbar) und Freude daran, Workflows zu bauen und zu betreuen.
* Sicherer Umgang mit modernen Enterprise\-AI\-Tools (z. B. Claude, ChatGPT) und Interesse daran, sie weiterzuentwickeln, einzuführen und zu governen. (Rechte\- \& Rollen\-Modell, Permissions, Connector\-Integration)
* Erfahrung im Anbinden von Datenquellen für verschiedene AI Use Cases, Aufbereitung \& Retrieval für (z. B. Embeddings, Vektor\-Suche, Reranking).
* Generelle technische Umsetzungsstärke (z. B. Python, APIs, Integrationen).
* Bewusstsein für Datenschutz, Sicherheit und Governance (inkl. DSGVO).
* Kenntnisse oder Interesse an agilen Methoden, Change\-Management und Projektkoordination.
* Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, motiviert, kommunikativ und teamübergreifend und begeisterst dich für neue AI\-Technologien.


 Das macht die Rolle besonders
   

  

 In dieser Rolle bist du nah an den Menschen, die AI nutzen: Du machst aus konkreten Bedürfnissen funktionierende Lösungen – ob als Workflow in n8n, als Use\-Case auf unserer Chat\-Plattform oder als Anwendung auf unserer KI\-Plattform. Du siehst unmittelbar, wie deine Arbeit im Unternehmen ankommt.
   

  

 Du arbeitest in einem Umfeld, das sich schnell entwickelt und in dem viele AI\-Themen gerade erst Form annehmen. Entsprechend breit ist das Themenfeld – von neuen Tools und Use\-Cases über Automatisierung bis zu unserer entstehenden KI\-Plattform. Wir suchen keine Spezialistin oder keinen Spezialisten für ein einzelnes Tool, sondern jemanden, der neue Technologien schnell versteht und in nachhaltige Lösungen übersetzt
   

  

 Warum wir?
   

  

 Bei The Quality Group arbeiten über 1\.200 Menschen mit einer gemeinsamen Mission: Ernährung neu zu denken \- gesünder, smarter und mit echtem Mehrwert für die Community.
   

  

 Wir glauben an Teamgeist, Eigenverantwortung und den Mut, Grenzen zu verschieben. Dabei zählt jeder Beitrag, unabhängig vom Standort oder Bereich.
   

  

 Je nachdem, wo du bei uns einsteigst, erwarten dich unterschiedliche Benefits, unter anderem:
   

  

  

* Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte auf Produkte von ESN \& More
* Flexible Arbeitszeiten \& Homeoffice\-Möglichkeiten
* Zuschüsse zu Mobilität \& Fitness (z. B. Wellpass, Deutschlandticket)
* Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
* Workation\-Optionen und mehr


 Im Bewerbungsprozess erfährst du, welche Vorteile dich an deinem Standort konkret erwarten und was es heißt, Teil von
 **TQG** 
 zu sein: Ein Unternehmen, das mit Leidenschaft, Qualität und Mut die Zukunft von Ernährung gestaltet.
   

  

 Über uns
   

  

 The Quality Group (TQG) ist ein innovativer Anbieter von Sporternährungsprodukten und vereint seit 2021 die erfolgreichen Marken ESN und More Nutrition.
   

  

 ESN ist seit 2004 deutscher Marktführer für Sporternährung und bietet Produkte wie Proteinpulver, Riegel und Supplements, die auf ambitionierte Fitnessziele ausgerichtet sind. More Nutrition, gegründet 2017, steht für gesunde, zuckerreduzierte Ernährungsprodukte und bietet Lösungen für bewusste Ernährung und Gewichtsmanagement – ohne Verzicht.
   

  

 Die Vision von TQG ist es, Menschen dabei zu unterstützen, die beste Version ihrer selbst zu werden. Mit Leidenschaft und Innovationskraft entwickelt das Unternehmen hochwertige Produkte, die Gesundheit, Leistung und Lebensfreude fördern. Mit einer agilen Unternehmenskultur und spannenden Karrieremöglichkeiten ist TQG nicht nur für Kunden, sondern auch für Mitarbeitende ein starker Partner.
   

  

**Das sind wir – The Quality Group – nice to meet you! Now it’s your turn!**
 Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft oder Identität – bei uns zählt, wer du bist und was du einbringst. Werde Teil unseres Teams und wachse mit uns.

title: AI Engineer / Software Engineer (all genders)
description:
Wir gehören zu den Top\-Adressen in der IT\-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT\-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.
   

  

**DEINE ROLLE**
* In a nutshell: In interdisziplinären Projektteams übernimmst du gemeinsam mit deinem Team abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten in technisch anspruchsvollen kundenspezifischen Softwareprojekten aus dem gesamten Engineering\-Prozess. Von der Anforderungsanalyse und dem fachlichen bzw. technischen Systementwurf über die Programmierung und Implementierung bis hin zur Qualitätssicherung und dem Projektmanagement. Die Projekte basierend auf dem bewährten Java\- / JavaScript\-Stack (Web\-Frontends mit Java Backends) und AI\-Prozessen (oft im Python\-Stack).
* AI\-Transformation: Du transformierst unsere Software\-Engineering\-Prozesse, indem du generative AI\-Tools (wie GitHub Copilot, Cursor, LLMs) in den gesamten SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) integrierst.
* Konzeption und Entwicklung: Du arbeitest in den Bereichen Konzeption, Entwicklung und Design von Java\- und AI\-Anwendungen in einem agilen Projektumfeld.
* Konzipiere Microservice\-Architekturen: Du konzipierst und realisierst moderne Microservice\-Architekturen und verteilte Systeme in vollem Umfang.
* Projektbegleitung: Von der Idee bis zum Go\-live begleitest du die Lösungen sorgfältig.


**DEIN PROFIL**
* Starker Hintergrund: Du bringst einen starken Hintergrund in Java\-Backend\-Entwicklung, AI\-Programmierung und Software\-Engineering mit.
* Java\-Backendentwicklung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Java\-Backendentwicklung webbasierter, skalierbarer Systeme und Anwendungen mit verschiedenen Datenbanken und Frameworks (z.B. Spring/Spring Boot, Hibernate) in einem agilen Projektumfeld helfen dir, alle Herausforderungen zu meistern. Du hast Spaß daran, Kunden durch die digitale Transformation in hochmoderne Prozesse zu führen.
* AI\-Programmierung: Praktische Kenntnisse in der Programmierung von AI\-Anwendungsfällen mit verschiedenen Frameworks bringst du ebenfalls mit.
* Generative AI: Du hast Interesse an generativer AI (GenAI, GPT, Gemini, Llama, LangChain/LlamaIndex und Co.) und erste Erfahrungen im Bereich MLOps.
* Sprachkenntnisse: Für deine Tätigkeit benötigst du sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1\-Level) und gute Englischkenntnisse.


 Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir\-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.
   

  

 Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home\-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1\. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer, Germany & Austria - BCG X
description:
**Locations** 
 : München \| Berlin \| Frankfurt \| Hamburg \| Köln \| Düsseldorf \| Stuttgart \| Vienna
   

  

 Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

**We Are BCG X**
 We’re a diverse team of more than 3,000 tech experts united by a drive to make a difference. Working across industries and disciplines, we combine our experience and expertise to tackle the biggest challenges faced by society today. We go beyond what was once thought possible, creating new and innovative solutions to the world’s most complex problems. Leveraging BCG’s global network and partnerships with leading organizations, BCG X provides a stable ecosystem for talent to build game\-changing businesses, products, and services from the ground up, all while growing their career. Together, we strive to create solutions that will positively impact the lives of millions.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 Our BCG X teams own the full analytics value\-chain end to end: framing new business challenges, designing innovative algorithms, implementing, and deploying scalable solutions, and enabling colleagues and clients to fully embrace AI. Our product offerings span from fully custom\-builds to industry specific leading edge AI software solutions.
   

  

 Our (Senior) Forward Deployed AI Engineers are part of our rapidly growing engineering team and help to build the next generation of AI solutions. You’ll have the chance to partner with clients in a variety of BCG regions and industries, and on key topics like climate change, enabling them to design, build, and deploy new and innovative solutions. Additional responsibilities will include developing and delivering thought leadership in scientific communities and papers as well as leading conferences on behalf of BCG X.
   

  

 \#BCGXjob
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

 We Are Looking For Dedicated Individuals With a Passion For Software Development, Large\-scale Data Analytics And Redefining Organizations Into AI Led Innovative Companies. Successful Candidates Possess The Following
   

  

* Apply software development practices and standards to develop robust and maintainable software
* Actively involved in every part of the software development process
* Experienced at guiding non\-technical teams and consultants in and best practices for robust software development
* Optimize and enhance computational efficiency of algorithms and software design
* Motivated by a fast\-paced, service\-oriented environment and interacting directly with clients on new features for future product releases
* Enjoy collaborating in diverse teams to share software design and solution ideas
* A natural problem\-solver and intellectually curious across a breadth of industries and topic
* Excellent oral and written communication skills in both German and English (C1/C2\)
* Bachelor's, Master's degree or PhD in relevant field of study \- please provide all academic certificates (A\-level, Bachelor, Master)


**Technologies**
 Programming Languages: Python, C\+\+, Java, JavaScript, ...
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**Professional Development**
 We are committed to your growth. You will have ample opportunities to participate in training programs, workshops, and development initiatives. title: Senior / Mid AI Engineer - Time Series
description:
**Transform the future of the built environment through purpose\-driven technology.** 



  


 Enzo is building AI systems that detect water leaks early, before damage happens. Our models process millions of time\-series sensor data points from real buildings every day, turning noisy signals into actionable risk insights for insurers and property owners.
 


  


 As an AI Engineer, you’ll strengthen our AI team by improving model quality, speed of iteration, and technical depth. You’ll work hands\-on with existing AI engineers, lead modeling decisions, and continuously bring new ideas into the system.
 


  


 This role is about better models, better learning, and real\-world performance, not research for its own sake.
 


  

 Tasks
   


**Role Overview** 



  


 You’ll own and advance the core AI logic behind Enzo’s leakage\-detection system. Your mission is to improve detection quality, robustness, and performance under real\-world constraint, while helping junior engineers grow and move faster.
 


  


 You will actively track relevant research, evaluate new approaches, and decide what is worth implementing, always with production impact in mind.
 


  


**Your Tasks** 



  


**Model Development \& Improvement** 



  

  
* Design, train, and evaluate time\-series models (and others) for water leakage and anomaly detection and automate work processes.
  
* Improve robustness to noise, drift, and real\-world data imperfections.
  
* Balance model complexity, accuracy, and inference performance.
  


  


**Technical Leadership \& Mentorship** 



  

  
* Work closely with other AI engineers on model design and experimentation.
  
* Review approaches, challenge assumptions, and answer technical questions.
  
* Help establish strong standards for experimentation and evaluation.
  


  


**Research Awareness \& Idea Generation** 



  

  
* Track relevant arXiv papers, applied ML research, and industry developments.
  
* Translate promising ideas into pragmatic experiments.
  
* Distinguish signals from hype, focus on what actually improves outcomes.
  


  


**Performance \& Speed** 



  

  
* Optimize training and inference performance.
  
* Push for faster iteration cycles and clearer experimental conclusions.
  
* Always ask:
 *does this materially improve detection in production?*
  


  


**Collaboration \& Deployment Awareness** 



  

  
* Work closely with MLOps and Engineering to ensure models are production\-ready.
  
* Design models with deployment, monitoring, and scaling in mind.
  


  

 Requirements
   


**Strong Applied ML Background** 



  

  
* Experience building and improving ML models beyond toy problems.
  
* Strong understanding of time\-series analysis, anomaly detection, and signal processing.
  
* Solid foundation in ML algorithms and statistical reasoning.
  


  


**Engineering Skills** 



  

  
* Strong Python skills.
  
* Experience with ML frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar).
  
* Comfortable working with large, real\-world datasets.
  


  


**Curiosity \& Judgment** 



  

  
* You actively follow AI research and news.
  
* You can explain
 *why* 
 an approach is worth trying, and why another isn’t.
  


  


**Startup Mindset** 



  

  
* You move fast and iterate pragmatically.
  
* You take ownership instead of waiting for perfect clarity.
  
* You enjoy working close to real data, real customers, and real constraints.
  


  


**Languages** 



  

  
* Fluent in English
  


  

 Benefits
   

  
* **Exposure:** 
 Work closely with Enzo's AI team, gaining insights into machine learning applications in IoT.
  
* **Impact:** 
 Your work will directly contribute to the development of our AI solutions for sustainable water management. Work on real\-world AI with immediate impact.
  
* **Learning \& Development:** 
 Gain hands\-on experience in AI, machine learning, and data analysis.
  
* **Growth Potential:** 
 You will have many opportunitoes to grow personally
  


  


 If you're ready to dive into the startup world and make a real impact with your AI expertise, we'd love to hear from you! Please send your resume and a brief cover letter explaining why you're interested in the
 **AI Engineer** 
 role at Enzo.

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
**TU MISIÓN**

**TU ROL** 




  





 El
 **Applied AI Engineer** 
 es el
 **ingeniero de plataforma de IA** 
 : construye el orquestador, define la arquitectura global y garantiza la calidad del sistema. Es el
 **dueño técnico de los componentes core** 
 que habilitan todas las soluciones de IA de la compañía y de los que dependen el resto de equipos técnicos.
 



 No construye agentes de dominio ni decide qué se automatiza: construye la
 **plataforma reutilizable sobre la que otros construyen** 
 . Su norte es la solidez del sistema a escala y la productividad que desbloquea en otros equipos.
 



  





**QUÉ HARÁS:** 



* **Diseñar la arquitectura del orquestador.** 
 Definir cómo razona el sistema, cómo se coordina con los agentes y cómo gestiona patrones secuenciales, paralelos, de routing y de fallback a escala. Establecer el modelo de confianza entre agentes, los estándares de comunicación y los contratos de interfaz que garantizan que el sistema escala sin romperse.
* **Construir los componentes core.** 
 Desarrollar el motor de orquestación y las librerías y SDKs internos que abstraen la interacción con LLMs, la memoria semántica, el tool calling y el manejo de contexto — para que los Forward Deployed construyan agentes rápidamente. Incluye los servicios de inferencia (API gateways, model routers, cachés semánticas) y los pipelines de RAG reutilizables como servicio.
* **Diseñar la memoria semántica de plataforma.** 
 Sistemas de memoria compartida a corto, medio y largo plazo, mecanismos de compactación y estrategia de persistencia a nivel de plataforma.
* **Ser dueño del framework de evaluación.** 
 Desarrollar el motor de evaluación de agentes: benchmarks, regression tests, evaluación de calidad de outputs y detección de degradación. Proporcionar herramientas estandarizadas y repetibles para que los Forward Deployed ejecuten evals, red teaming y certifiquen agentes antes de producción.
* **Operar la IA en producción.** 
 CI/CD para IA (versionado de prompts, tests de regresión, canary deployments), observabilidad end\-to\-end, dashboards de rendimiento, alertas de drift y degradación, y logging estructurado de interacciones.
* **Optimizar coste y latencia.** 
 Monitorizar y reducir proactivamente el consumo de tokens, las latencias y los costes de infraestructura con técnicas de caching, batching, model routing y context pruning — con impacto directo en los unit economics de IA.
* **Habilitar al resto de equipos.** 
 Mantener documentación de APIs, SDKs y patrones de integración, y garantizar que cada componente sea reutilizable por múltiples agentes y equipos, evitando soluciones ad\-hoc que no escalen.



  





**EXPERIENCIA (IMPRESCINDIBLE)** 



* **Arquitectura multi\-agente** 
 : diseño de sistemas multi\-agente, patrones de orquestación, routing, planning y modelo de confianza. Capaz de diseñar el sistema completo de forma autónoma.
* **Experiencia con frameworks agénticos** 
 : LangGraph, Mastra o similares— internals y extensibilidad, capaz de extender y customizar frameworks.
* **RAG \& retrieval** 
 : arquitecturas avanzadas, hybrid search, reranking y evaluación (RAGAS u otros). Componente crítico de la plataforma.
* **LLMs \& model serving:** 
 funcionamiento de transformers, fine\-tuning, quantización, distillation y model serving, con comprensión profunda para optimizar y operar.
* **Evaluación y testing de IA** 
 : eval frameworks, benchmark design, regression testing, red teaming y A/B testing.
* **Diseño de APIs \& SDKs (avanzado)** 
 : REST/gRPC, versionado, SDKs internos y documentación técnica — creas herramientas que usan otros ingenieros.



  





**EXPERIENCIA (MUY VALORABLE)** 



* **Cloud \& infraestructura** 
 : Azure/GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, serverless y arquitecturas event\-driven para IA.
* **Observabilidad** 
 : LangSmith, Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Datadog y Grafana.
* **Seguridad \& gobernanza** 
 : guardrails, content filtering, PII detection y audit logging.
* **Optimización de costes** 
 : token management, caching semántico, model routing, batching y context pruning.
* **Lenguajes de programación Typescript \& Python**



  





**TRABAJARÁS CON:** 




 Este rol construye la plataforma sobre la que trabajan el resto de equipos de Tecnología, que ya tienen ownership claro y contexto profundo de negocio:
 


* **Forward Deployed Engineers** 
 — Son tus principales clientes internos. Construyen agentes de dominio sobre tus librerías, SDKs y herramientas de evaluación. Tu éxito se mide por la productividad que les desbloqueas; tú construyes las herramientas que ellos consumen.
* **Agent Product Managers** 
 — Definen los requisitos funcionales de los agentes que la plataforma debe soportar, los criterios de éxito a nivel de sistema y las prioridades de evolución del orquestador. Tú no priorizas qué se automatiza; eso lo decide Producto.
* **Data Engineers (AI Focus)**
